title: [LOGGED OUT] "Referral program" panel opens with its texts and closes again

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/ and wait until loaded.
If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
steps.saw: Banner shown, Dismiss clicked, banner gone

steps.text: Click the white "Referral program" button at the bottom right.
Does a panel show "get bonuses together!" and "Bring friends and enjoy bonuses when they make first purchases. Your friends will also get rewards."?
steps.saw: Panel shows "Invite friends — get bonuses together!" and "Bring friends and enjoy bonuses when they make first purchases. Your friends will also get rewards."

steps.text: Does the panel show "You will get:" "Emeralds x100, Gold x1000" and "Your friend will get:" "Emeralds x650, Gold x10000"?
steps.saw: "You will get:" Emeralds x100, Gold x1000 (x1); "Your friend will get:" Emeralds x650, Gold x10000 (x1)

steps.text: Are an "Invite friends" button and a "Log in to view rewards" button shown (do not click them)?
steps.saw: Green "Invite friends" button and outlined "Log in to view rewards" button shown

steps.text: Click the round X button at the bottom right.
steps.saw: Clicked the round toggle button in the referral iframe (ref of the 'Referral program' button, which showed as the round X)
Panel gone, white "Referral program" button back at bottom right
